description: Immutable snapshot of the comment editor draft state in TmActivityComments. Consumers build a dirty-guard from it (confirmation before discarding an in-progress comment). Carries state flags only — never the draft text itself; the text is delivered in OnCommentAdded/OnCommentEdited on submit. HasUnsavedContent: for a new comment it means non-empty content, for an edit it means the content differs from the original body.
